- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Celtic languages contributed loanwords to French prior to the Roman conquest.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Spanish has influenced French, especially in regions bordering Spain, with borrowed words and expressions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dutch words have been adopted into French, particularly in commerce and sailing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Portuguese has influenced French through trade, with words related to sailing like "bateau" (boat) and "cabestan" (capstan).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Greek has impacted French, especially in science and medicine, with many technical terms derived from ancient Greek.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Breton language has influenced French, particularly in agriculture and food.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yiddish has contributed several words to French, particularly in relation to food and culture.
